name: v14-chunked-file
description: Past 512 listed accounts the rows go in chunk files of 512 and the tree in chunks under the root over their roots. Epoch 1 lists 10 accounts, in its index; epoch 2 lists 1,100 - 1,090 new holders between the old ones in address order, and one old holder who sold out and keeps its leaf - so its index names three chunks (512, 512 and 76 rows) and lists none.
covers: rows in the index up to 512 accounts
the tree in chunks and the root over their roots
a sold-out holder keeps its leaf in a chunk
cumulative values carried from an index into chunks
